pages.text: The $(bold)Life Lamp Ring$() is a cursed tool worn in a Curios $(bold)ring slot$().$(br2)While its wick burns, no one beneath it may die - $(bold)no damage you deal can ever kill your target$():$(li)A lethal blow is cut short, leaving the target at $(bold)1 health$()$(li)If the target's max health is below 40 (1 health would already be above the 2.5% execute line of $(l:cursed_spirit)Cursed Spirit Manipulation$()), they are left at $(bold)2% of their max health$() instead - still unkillable, but inside capture range$(li)The only test is $(bold)whether the attacker is you$() - flying swords, magic bolts and commanded servants all count$(br2)$(bold)It cuts damage, never death$(): mechanics that work by killing - capture, execution - are $(bold)unaffected$().$(br2)$(bold)It also nullifies the first curse of the Ring of Seven Curses$() (double damage from any source) - while the ring is worn, that curse no longer applies.$(br2)$(bold)Exception$(): $(bold)true piercing damage is not bound by mercy$() - piercing melee and projectiles can still kill.$(br2)$(bold)Mercy is the greatest evil; even good intent may bear karmic fruit.$()

It $(bold)protects only your foes, never you$() - damage you take is settled as usual, and a target already at 1 health takes no further damage.$(br2)Take the ring off when you mean to finish someone.$(br2)$(italic)Pinning an enemy at one breath from death is sometimes crueller than killing it outright.$()

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: $(bold)Life Lamp Ring$() is made by the $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() (the same recipe is shown in JEI):$(br2)$(bold)Core slot$() (the lantern directly above the ore):$(li)1 x Reverse Cursed Technique$(br2)$(bold)Material slots$() (the other 8 lanterns):$(li)1 x Iron Nugget$(li)1 x Gold Nugget$(li)1 x Nicholas' Blessing$(li)1 x Soul Lantern$(li)1 x Blue Orchid$(li)1 x Rose Bush$(li)1 x Cornflower$(br2)$(bold)Curse cost$(): $(bold)5000$()$(br2)Note: material $(bold)counts must be exact$() - one extra item and the ritual will not start. See $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() for the structure.
